base_member_text: tight_subplot (L38) is a third-party helper that must exist on the MATLAB path; not shipped in this directory as far as this file shows
audit_member_text: tight_subplot at L38 is a non-core external function with no availability check or local fallback; the plotting path stops before axes creation when it is absent.

base_member_text: the factor 2680*1000.0 (L87) converts volumetric concentration to mg/L assuming sediment density 2680 kg/m^3; this provenance is not stated in the file
mirroring uses dep(n-1:-1:1,:) (L36) so row n is the symmetry axis and appears once; consistency with the model's half-domain symmetry boundary cannot be verified here
the still-water-line x-extent [15.7 102.32] (L159) is hard-coded; its derivation from the channel geometry is not in the file
mint labels (L21) correspond to the commented 3-snapshot set (L19); with nfile=[120] the title lines using mint are also commented (L75, L90)
DEP mirrored array is used only for the profile plot -DEP(:,1) (L157); mask uses threshold mask<1 (L51-L52) rather than mask==0 as in sibling scripts

audit_member_text: Cross-iteration overwrite: the loop at L41 can contain multiple nfile entries, but ETA, CH, BEDS, BEDB, and BB are overwritten at L55-L66. The summary after the loop at L141-L165 therefore represents only the last frame, while earlier frames leave no separate summary.

The same four axes ha(1:4) are reused on every iteration at L84-L121 without an explicit clear or replacement policy; with multiple nfile values, successive graphics may replace or layer inconsistently rather than produce one frame-specific figure.

Shape assumptions are unchecked: every loaded field at L44-L48 is assigned into n-by-m slices at L55-L64 using dimensions obtained only from dep at L8. Any discrepant shape fails at assignment, and mask is applied to eta/ch at L51-L52 without first checking matching dimensions.

Mask propagation is inconsistent: eta and ch are set to NaN where mask<1 at L51-L52, but beds and bedb are not masked before BEDS/BEDB/BB are formed at L60-L66, so dry/invalid cells can contribute to the mean B at L144.
The logarithm at L87 has no positivity guard. Unmasked zero CH produces -Inf and negative CH produces non-real values before pcolor/caxis; mask<1 at L52 does not guarantee CH>0.

ETA contains NaNs introduced at L51 and mirrored at L55-L56, but extrema at L147-L148 do not request omission of NaNs; affected rows can yield missing envelope values depending on MATLAB version/defaults.
